what: When a member shares routines as text or a file, end the message with one line that gets a friend the app ("Get MettleUp free: <Play link>"), and for a gym member the gym's Bring a friend link instead
why: Today the routine text ends with a bare "Made with MettleUp" and the file is a .json the friend cannot open without the app, so a routine sent on WhatsApp is a dead end for anyone who does not already have MettleUp. Hevy's routine links (hevy.com/routine/..., hevy.com/folder/...) open a web page that shows the routine and offers the app (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live; the app's own Hevy link reader relies on those pages).
impact_why: Routines are the thing gym friends swap most; every share is a free invite, and it costs one line of text
my_view: My view: do the one link line now (not the same as the workout-share footer idea, which covers workout pictures only). A web page that shows a shared routine, like Hevy's, is a bigger build; leave it until shares are measured.

what: After deleting a saved workout, show "Workout deleted" with Undo for about 10 seconds before it is really removed
why: Delete removes the workout, its photos and its records straight away with no way back; a slip of the thumb on the Profile feed or the workout page loses a real session for good
impact_why: Rare, but losing a logged workout (and a record that came with it) is the kind of thing members remember and review about
my_view: My view: worth doing with the same Undo bar proposed for discarding a live workout, so both work one way; build both together.

what: Offer an optional "10 seconds left" short buzz (phone and watch) before rest ends, so the member is under the bar when the bell goes
why: The app has only two sounds: rest over and a new record. Members walking around between sets hear the bell late and then spend 10 to 20 seconds getting set, which quietly stretches every rest
impact_why: Nice for serious lifters on a watch; most members are fine with the bell
my_view: My view: a small switch, off by default, under the rest-over sound choice; buzz only, never a second sound, so the gym is not noisier. Not urgent.

what: Include the profile photo in the opt-in "Include photos in my backup", next to the progress photos
why: The profile photo is never backed up, so after a new phone or a reinstall the Profile shows a letter again even for a member who turned photo backup on
impact_why: One small photo; a polish fix for members who already chose to back up photos
my_view: My view: do it when photo backup is next touched; one more file in the same folder, same opt-in, no new promise needed.

what: Let a member make a before-and-after picture from two progress photos they pick (dates and "8 weeks apart" on it, the gym's logo for a gym member), shared only when they tap Share
why: Progress photos are private and only compared on the phone. Before-and-after posts are what Indian gym members already share on Instagram and WhatsApp status, and a gym-branded one is free marketing for the gym owner who pays for MettleUp
impact_why: A proud moment members already want to post; puts the gym and the app in front of their friends
my_view: My view: build it, but only member-started, never suggested over a photo, and fix the open "Before and after can be swapped" problem first so the picture never shows the newer photo as Before.

what: On an exercise with no "Watch your trainer" video, give a gym member a small "Ask my trainer for a video" that sends a short note to the gym's inbox
why: Trainer videos appear only where the trainer happened to put a link in a plan or the workout of the day; a member stuck on form has no way to ask for one, and the trainer never learns which moves members want shown
impact_why: Builds the member-trainer link that keeps members renewing, but only for gyms whose trainers add videos
my_view: My view: later; first check how many gyms put videos in plans at all. If few do, skip it.
